name: Noyama Tsubaki
source:
She is the eldest daughter of the Noyama family, who is a teacher at Academy, on which Ringo attends.
She has a gentle personality that makes everyone around her feel at ease. But, she can also be quite scary when she gets angry. She loves to spoil Ringo with maternal love and her big breasts. However, she is no good at housework and relies on Ringo.
